ChangeHunk.description: An immutable diff identity with a mutable review decision.

conflict.description: Why rollback was refused; no forced rollback is available.

newStart.description: Historical turn-final coordinate, with the same unified diff convention.

oldStart.description: Historical baseline -> turn-final unified diff coordinates, never live filesystem positions. Nonempty starts are one-based; empty ranges use the preceding line number (zero at BOF). Use hunk/locate for navigation.

patch.description: Unified diff hunk, preserving line endings and missing-final-newline markers.

ChangeReviewState.description: Aggregate review state. Mixed terminal decisions are `Reviewed`.

ChangeSet.description: One finalized logical change set per turn. Review does not regenerate IDs.

coverage.description: MVP coverage is `applyPatchOnly`: arbitrary shell/MCP writes are not tracked.

revision.description: Monotonic decision revision; clients can discard delayed notifications.

storage.description: Storage is `sessionMemory`: restart/unload loses review data.

ChangeSetFile.description: A file's first baseline and last exact Codex result, never Git HEAD.

beforeContent.description: UTF-8 content for native IDE diffs. Null means absent or unsupported.

path.description: Absolute path URI, consistent with executor environment addressing.

unsupportedReason.description: Unsupported files are visible but cannot be accepted or reverted.

ChangeSetFileKind.description: Text file presence relative to its first mutation in the turn.

ChangeSetHunkResult.description: Per-hunk outcome, including unchanged accepted/reverted/conflicted hunks in bulk calls.

description: Complete snapshot and individual outcomes, including partial success. A rollback conflict is a normal result, not a JSON-RPC failure. Invalid IDs and attempts to review a running thread are JSON-RPC errors.
title: ChangeSetReviewResponse
